questions.question: When God appeared to King Solomon in a dream at Gibeon, what did God say to him?

answers.text: Ask and I will give it to you
Go and tear down the high places
Rise and lead My people out

questions.question: When God appeared to King Solomon in a dream, what did Solomon ask God to give him?

answers.text: A heart to judge with understanding
Wealth to build a great kingdom

questions.question: After Solomon asked for an understanding heart, what did God say He would also give him that he had not asked for?
God told King Solomon that someday another king would be as wise as him. True or false?
